definitions.gloss: nonsensical; irrelevant; off the mark; absurd
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is completely off-base, irrelevant, or absurdly wrong. Often used for answers, responses, or behavior that misses the point entirely.

examples.japanese: {頓珍漢|とんちんかん}な⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{頓珍漢|とんちんかん}なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。

⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{理解|りかい}していない→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧、{頓珍漢|とんちんかん}な⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Maybe he doesn't understand the questions, because he keeps giving completely irrelevant answers.

notes:
Describes something absurdly off the mark or irrelevant. Can function as a na-adjective ({頓珍漢|とんちんかん}な) or as a noun. The kanji are ateji (phonetic spellings with no semantic connection to the meaning).

ETYMOLOGY:
Said to derive from the alternating sounds of hammers at a blacksmith's forge — when two smiths strike out of rhythm, it sounds like "ton-chin-kan," evoking the idea of being out of sync or off-beat.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頓珍漢|とんちんかん}な⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧: an off-the-mark answer
- {頓珍漢|とんちんかん}なこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say nonsensical things
- {頓珍漢|とんちんかん}な⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧: an irrelevant question
- {頓珍漢|とんちんかん}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: absurd behavior

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{的外|まとはず}れ→的外れ：16719_matohazure⟧: off the mark — describes missing the point, less colorful
- ⟦{見当違|けんとうちが}い→見当違い：18771_kentouchigai⟧: barking up the wrong tree — fundamentally misunderstanding the situation
- ⟦ちぐはぐ→ちぐはぐ：18852_chiguhagu⟧: mismatched, inconsistent — things that don't fit together properly
